# Paved plugin 2.0.0

Paved gives a repository a durable operating model for agent work. Invoke Paved commands (init, status, plan, feature, fix, refactor, test, verify, review and more) and the bundled launcher activates the version-pinned, integrity-checked Paved runtime under the repository's .paved/runtime/ directory. Workflows, Tool execution, verification and evidence are decided by that runtime; the plugin only distributes and invokes it.

This directory is the installable plugin for Claude Code. It is generated by
`npm run build:plugin` in the Paved repository and must not be edited by hand.

- Runtime: `paved-core@2.1.0` unpacked at `runtime/paved-core/`; Claude Code installs its dependencies from `package-lock.json`.
- Runtime integrity: `sha512-vQdeJJ8YR+r0i3JA+81m9yDGMwmbotvJj9VvHFRFdwvebUVBvourJATk+uqC8zb6M4fU8rvvSJ17eqQsknNvoQ==`, checked over the runtime and its dependencies before activation
- Launcher: `scripts/paved.mjs`
- Prompt routing: `hooks/hooks.json` adds advisory Paved context once per session in repositories initialized with Paved, and again after compaction.
- Skills: `/paved:<command>`

Installation and usage: https://github.com/andersonmrodrigues/paved/blob/main/docs/getting-started/installing-the-plugin.md
